text: Youth is a time of maturing and opportunity, and the brain is still developing. Encourage your teen to make age-appropriate decisions, take on clear responsibilities and plan for the future, and stand by them as they learn from mistakes.

review_defects.why: Arabic uses 'ابنك' (your son) but English says 'your teen', losing the specific familial and masculine reference; similarly 'له' (him) becomes 'them'.
